name: Remove Passkey Success
summary: An authenticated existing user removes one passkey credential owned by the current durable identity and remains signed in as the same user.
finalOutcome: The selected passkey credential is removed from the current durable identity, other credentials are unchanged, and the active session identity is unchanged.

sourceReferences.note: The server exposes user-bound passkey removal and enforces credential ownership before deletion.
Passkey Management V1 models Add Passkey and Remove Passkey as the user-visible management outcomes. Rename remains an available server capability but is not required product surface for this pass.
